name: io.github.DasRed/backrest-mcp
title: Backrest
description: Monitor and run restic backups in Backrest: plans, snapshots, operations, logs. Read-only by default

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Port mapping host:container. The URL below assumes host port 3000.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: "Bearer <token>", only needed when BACKREST_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN is set

environmentVariables.name: BACKREST_MCP_BACKREST_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of Backrest as reachable from the container

environmentVariables.name: BACKREST_MCP_BACKREST_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Backrest user for HTTP basic auth, leave empty if authentication is disabled in Backrest

environmentVariables.name: BACKREST_MCP_BACKREST_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of that user, required together with the username

environmentVariables.name: BACKREST_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma separated tool names to keep, * as wildcard

environmentVariables.name: BACKREST_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
environmentVariables.description: Comma separated tool names to remove, * as wildcard

environmentVariables.name: BACKREST_MCP_MASK_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Replace repository passwords and hook tokens with ******** in returned configs

environmentVariables.name: BACKREST_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: If set, the MCP endpoint requires Authorization: Bearer <token>

environmentVariables.name: BACKREST_MCP_BACKREST_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public URL of Backrest for download links, defaults to BACKREST_MCP_BACKREST_URL

environmentVariables.name: BACKREST_MCP_BACKREST_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Request timeout against Backrest in milliseconds
